courses.title: Winter Restorative and Social with Helen Clay
courses.description: A two-hour restorative Iyengar workshop at the centre, led by Helen Clay and open to all levels including beginners. Supported poses for warmth, rest and balance at a busy time of year, followed by tea and mince pies.
